title: UNDER HIS FEATHERS
PSALM 91:4 PRAYER
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: If fear is quietly whispering about tomorrow while you sit in this room, listen closely.
Psalm 91 verse 4 promises, He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust:
his truth shall be his shield and buckler. Heavenly Father, wrap this tired heart beneath Your shadow tonight.
Surround every vulnerable place with Your unyielding truth. Where panic attempts to enter, let Your living presence stand
as a mighty fortress and wall of safety. May Your faithful covering guard every thought,
every journey, and every quiet hour. Rest peacefully, knowing God remains your constant shield.
